tweaks.title: Enable Windows Game Mode
tweaks.description: Let Windows recognize games and prioritize the gaming workload. Results depend on the Windows build and competing applications.
tweaks.caveat: Does not set game process priority or guarantee more FPS. Restart a running game after changing this.

tweaks.title: Disable Windows game recording
tweaks.description: Disable Windows Game DVR capture and its recording component to avoid optional capture work while playing.
tweaks.caveat: Windows Game Bar clips and capture are unavailable. OBS and NVIDIA recording have separate settings.

tweaks.title: Stop controller button opening Game Bar
tweaks.description: Prevent the Xbox/controller button from opening the Game Bar overlay during a session.
tweaks.caveat: Only changes the controller shortcut. Other overlays are unaffected.

tweaks.title: Disable pointer acceleration
tweaks.description: Use a consistent Windows pointer response by turning off Enhance pointer precision and its acceleration thresholds.
tweaks.caveat: CS2 uses raw mouse input, so this mainly affects the desktop and games that use the Windows pointer. It does not change mouse polling rate.

tweaks.title: Disable mouse pointer trails
tweaks.description: Remove the trailing pointer effect for a cleaner cursor image on the desktop.
tweaks.caveat: A visual preference; does not reduce USB or game input latency.

tweaks.title: Disable Ctrl pointer locator
tweaks.description: Stop Windows drawing a locator ring when you press Ctrl.
tweaks.caveat: May remove a useful accessibility aid. It does not change raw game input.

tweaks.title: Disable automatic pointer snapping
tweaks.description: Keep Windows from automatically moving the cursor to the default button in dialogs.
tweaks.caveat: Affects Windows dialogs rather than CS2 mouse movement.

tweaks.title: Keep pointer visible while typing
tweaks.description: Disable the Windows preference that temporarily hides the pointer while you type.
tweaks.caveat: A cursor visibility preference only; games may draw their own cursor.

tweaks.title: Disable Sticky Keys and its shortcut
tweaks.description: Turn off Sticky Keys and the repeated-Shift shortcut so it cannot interrupt a game.
tweaks.caveat: Disables an accessibility feature. Leave unchanged if you rely on latched modifier keys.

tweaks.title: Disable Filter Keys and its shortcut
tweaks.description: Turn off Filter Keys and its shortcut so Windows does not intentionally ignore short or repeated keystrokes.
tweaks.caveat: Disables an accessibility feature. Normal keyboards already process keys without Filter Keys delay.

tweaks.title: Disable Toggle Keys shortcut
tweaks.description: Disable Toggle Keys and its held-Num-Lock shortcut to prevent accidental lock-key sound prompts.
tweaks.caveat: Removes lock-key accessibility sounds. No reduction in game input latency is promised.

tweaks.title: Use fast Windows key repeat
tweaks.description: Set the shortest initial repeat delay and fastest repeat rate for Windows text controls and menus.
tweaks.caveat: Does not accelerate the first keypress, hardware scan rate or CS2 movement input. Text may repeat more easily.

tweaks.title: Disable typing statistics
tweaks.description: Stop Windows collecting typing insights for supported keyboard suggestions.
tweaks.caveat: A privacy preference with little expected performance effect. Does not modify keyboard drivers.

tweaks.title: Disable hardware keyboard predictions
tweaks.description: Turn off Windows text predictions for a physical keyboard in supported text fields.
tweaks.caveat: Affects typing suggestions rather than raw game input.

tweaks.title: Disable desktop transparency
tweaks.description: Use opaque Windows surfaces instead of optional transparency effects.
tweaks.caveat: May lighten desktop composition. It is not an NVIDIA graphics setting or a guaranteed in-game FPS gain.

tweaks.title: Disable minimize and maximize animations
tweaks.description: Make supported desktop window transitions immediate instead of animated.
tweaks.caveat: Improves the feel of desktop window switching; does not change game frame pacing.

tweaks.title: Disable taskbar animations
tweaks.description: Remove optional taskbar button animation effects.
tweaks.caveat: A desktop visual preference. Windows versions may show fewer affected animations.

tweaks.title: Use window outlines while dragging
tweaks.description: Show an outline while moving windows rather than repeatedly drawing the whole window contents.
tweaks.caveat: Changes desktop dragging behavior and does not affect an already running fullscreen game.

tweaks.title: Use simple selection rectangles
tweaks.description: Disable translucent Explorer selection rectangles in supported views.
tweaks.caveat: A small Explorer visual preference with no expected CS2 FPS benefit.

tweaks.title: Disable desktop icon label shadows
tweaks.description: Remove the shadow effect behind desktop icon text.
tweaks.caveat: Can make labels harder to read against some wallpapers. Does not change game rendering.

tweaks.title: Disable Aero Peek
tweaks.description: Stop Windows temporarily previewing the desktop through transparent application windows.
tweaks.caveat: Affects desktop preview behavior. Does not disable the Desktop Window Manager.

tweaks.title: Reduce Windows menu opening delay
tweaks.description: Set the Windows menu hover delay to 100 ms for quicker supported desktop menus.
tweaks.caveat: Changes menu interaction only; it does not reduce click-to-photon latency in games.

tweaks.title: Mute Windows app notification banners
tweaks.description: Turn off Windows app toast notifications so banners do not distract you during a session.
tweaks.caveat: Applies outside games too. You may miss useful app messages; security controls remain enabled.

tweaks.title: Hide lock screen app notifications
tweaks.description: Prevent ordinary app notification banners from being displayed above the lock screen.
tweaks.caveat: A lock-screen privacy preference, with no direct FPS benefit.

tweaks.title: Disable suggested apps in Start
tweaks.description: Turn off supported Start menu promotional app suggestions.
tweaks.caveat: Does not uninstall apps. Newer Start recommendation features may use additional controls.

tweaks.title: Disable Windows tips and suggestions
tweaks.description: Stop supported Windows usage tips and soft-landing promotional suggestions.
tweaks.caveat: Only controls Windows suggestions, not app notifications or security status.

tweaks.title: Disable Settings promotional suggestions
tweaks.description: Turn off the supported suggested-content feeds in the Settings application.
tweaks.caveat: Windows builds may retire individual content feeds. No game performance gain is promised.

tweaks.title: Disable silent suggested app promotions
tweaks.description: Opt out of supported Content Delivery Manager suggestions that silently provision promoted consumer apps.
tweaks.caveat: Does not uninstall existing apps or prevent the Microsoft Store from updating them.

tweaks.title: Disable finish-setting-up reminders
tweaks.description: Stop the supported post-install reminder to finish configuring optional Windows experiences.
tweaks.caveat: Does not disable Windows Update, activation or security checks.

tweaks.title: Disable Windows welcome promotions
tweaks.description: Turn off the supported Windows welcome experience suggestions after updates and sign-in.
tweaks.caveat: Affects welcome content only. Operating-system updates continue normally.

tweaks.title: Disable lock screen Spotlight content
tweaks.description: Stop supported rotating Windows Spotlight content and overlay tips on the lock screen.
tweaks.caveat: Changes the lock screen presentation; existing local images are not deleted.

tweaks.title: Disable Explorer provider suggestions
tweaks.description: Hide sync-provider promotional notifications shown inside File Explorer.
tweaks.caveat: Does not disable OneDrive, syncing, backups or Explorer security warnings.

tweaks.title: Disable Windows 11 Widgets
tweaks.description: Disable the optional Windows Widgets board and its associated feed experience through the Windows policy.
tweaks.caveat: Windows 11 only. Removes the Widgets board, weather and related feed access. Sign out after applying.

tweaks.title: Disable Windows 10 News and interests
tweaks.description: Disable the optional Windows 10 taskbar news and weather feed using its policy.
tweaks.caveat: Windows 10 only. This setting does not apply to the Windows 11 Widgets board.

tweaks.title: Hide Explorer frequent folders
tweaks.description: Remove frequently used folders from the visible File Explorer Quick Access/Home list.
tweaks.caveat: A navigation/privacy preference. Pinned folders remain and no files are removed.

tweaks.title: Disable Explorer cloud file recommendations
tweaks.description: Prevent account-based Microsoft 365 cloud items from being shown as recent items in supported File Explorer views.
tweaks.caveat: Windows 11 22H2 or later. Does not disable cloud sync or delete cloud files.

tweaks.title: Stop reopening apps after sign-in
tweaks.description: Opt out of automatically saving and reopening supported restartable apps after a Windows restart.
tweaks.caveat: Does not disable ordinary startup entries, security services or application auto-start settings.

tweaks.title: Stop Edge background and startup boost
tweaks.description: Disable Edge startup boost and its background mode after its last window closes.
tweaks.caveat: Requires a detected machine-wide Edge installation. Restart Edge to apply. Browser launch may be slower and background extensions may stop.

tweaks.title: Stop Chrome background applications
tweaks.description: Prevent Chrome background apps from continuing after all Chrome windows close.
tweaks.caveat: Requires a detected machine-wide Chrome installation. Restart Chrome to apply. Background extensions and app notifications may stop.

tweaks.title: Disable Windows advertising ID
tweaks.description: Stop supported apps from using the Windows advertising identifier for personalized ads.
tweaks.caveat: A privacy choice, with no measurable game-performance gain assumed.

tweaks.title: Disable tailored diagnostic experiences
tweaks.description: Opt out of personalized recommendations that use Windows diagnostic data.
tweaks.caveat: Does not disable security telemetry, diagnostics services or required diagnostic data.

tweaks.title: Disable cloud clipboard sync
tweaks.description: Prevent Windows clipboard contents from being synchronized across devices.
tweaks.caveat: Cross-device clipboard is unavailable. Local copy and paste continue working.

tweaks.title: Disable clipboard history
tweaks.description: Stop Windows maintaining the optional Win+V clipboard history.
tweaks.caveat: Win+V history becomes unavailable. This does not promise secure erasure of previously stored data.

tweaks.title: Disable account cloud search
tweaks.description: Stop Windows Search including supported personal Microsoft and work/school cloud-account content.
tweaks.caveat: Local indexed search is retained. Not a network-latency or game FPS setting.

tweaks.title: Disable device search history
tweaks.description: Turn off local Windows Search history used to improve search suggestions.
tweaks.caveat: Does not disable the Windows Search indexer or remove existing index data.

tweaks.title: Disable Search highlights
tweaks.description: Stop dynamic Search highlight content such as trending topics and illustrated suggestions.
tweaks.caveat: Supported on Windows builds with Search highlights. Ordinary local search continues working.

tweaks.title: Disable search-box web suggestions
tweaks.description: Disable supported search-box web suggestions so Start/search is focused on local content.
tweaks.caveat: Windows editions and servicing updates can vary in how search policies are honored. Does not affect browser search.

tweaks.title: Disable app launch tracking
tweaks.description: Stop Windows tracking app launches for Start and search personalization.
tweaks.caveat: Frequently used app recommendations become less personalized. No direct FPS increase is expected.

tweaks.title: Disable recently opened item history
tweaks.description: Stop displaying recently opened items in supported Start, taskbar Jump Lists and Explorer recent views.
tweaks.caveat: Recent item shortcuts become unavailable. Existing documents are not deleted.

tweaks.title: Restrict Store app background activity
tweaks.description: Use the Windows app privacy policy to deny supported Store apps permission to run in the background.
tweaks.caveat: May stop background notifications, mail updates or app sync. Does not terminate desktop applications and does not affect all system apps.

tweaks.title: Disable inking and typing learning
tweaks.description: Restrict implicit Windows text and handwriting collection used for input personalization.
tweaks.caveat: May reduce personalized word or handwriting suggestions. Does not change game mouse input processing.

tweaks.title: Disable peer-to-peer update sharing
tweaks.description: Set Delivery Optimization to HTTP-only mode, preventing optional peer-to-peer update uploads and downloads.
tweaks.caveat: Windows Update and Store downloads remain enabled. This is not a bandwidth cap and cannot guarantee lower game ping.

tweaks.title: Allow full CPU performance on AC
tweaks.description: Set the active power plan maximum processor state to 100% when plugged in, removing a Windows power-plan CPU cap.
tweaks.caveat: Often already 100%. Can increase heat if an existing cap was intentional. Does not overclock or override firmware power limits.

tweaks.title: Allow normal CPU idle on AC
tweaks.description: Set the active power plan minimum processor state to 5%, allowing the CPU to idle instead of holding an unnecessary minimum clock.
tweaks.caveat: A thermal and efficiency preference, not a promise of more FPS. Actual behavior depends on Intel hardware power management.

tweaks.title: Prefer CPU performance on AC
tweaks.description: Set the processor energy-performance preference to performance on supported hardware, including compatible Intel Speed Shift systems.
tweaks.caveat: May increase power use, fan noise and temperature. Measure sustained frame times; thermal throttling can make results worse.

tweaks.title: Allow aggressive CPU boost on AC
tweaks.description: Select aggressive processor boost mode in the active AC power plan, where supported by the CPU and firmware.
tweaks.caveat: Optional, not overclocking. Can increase heat and power. Firmware limits still apply; do not use to compensate for inadequate cooling.

tweaks.title: Disable USB selective suspend on AC
tweaks.description: Keep Windows from selectively suspending idle USB devices in the active AC power plan.
tweaks.caveat: Only consider for reproducible peripheral sleep/wake problems. Increases idle power and does not raise mouse polling rate or guarantee lower active input latency.

tweaks.title: Disable PCIe link idle savings on AC
tweaks.description: Turn off active power plan PCI Express Link State Power Management while plugged in.
tweaks.caveat: Optional for measured link wake-related issues. Can increase idle heat and power. It does not set RTX 3060 NVIDIA performance mode.

tweaks.title: Keep hard disks awake on AC
tweaks.description: Set the active plan hard-disk idle timeout to never while plugged in, avoiding HDD spin-up waits.
tweaks.caveat: Relevant to mechanical disks that actually spin down. No SSD or CS2 FPS gain is expected; HDD noise and power use can increase.

profiles.name: Clean baseline
profiles.description: Conservative Game Mode, capture, pointer and Windows suggestion preferences. No power-plan or accessibility changes.

profiles.name: CS2 focus
profiles.description: A measured starting point for the i5-14600 / RTX 3060 / 32 GB target: Game Mode, no Windows recording or pointer effects, fewer promotions and no peer update sharing. CS2 raw input is already separate from desktop acceleration.
